text:
olivia_sales: Team — Meridian has a partner showcase next week and wants a 40m live POC. They plan browser clients with streaming, ~140 concurrent users, intermittent spikes up to ~900 RPS for a few minutes. Request: ephemeral hosted key + temporary QPS bump + optional IP allowlist. Need key by Thu EOD.

ben_eng: Thanks. Quick clarifying q's: region? avg tokens per req? are they ok with model fallback?

olivia_sales: Region = eu-west-1. Avg tokens/request ~75. They want graceful fallback but prefer automatic downgrade to a smaller model rather than hard failure.

harry_sre: Rough calc: worst-case sustained 5m spike at 900 RPS -> 900 * 75 * 300 = 20,250,000 tokens. Baseline traffic rest of window ~140 RPS * 75 * 2400 = 25,200,000. Total ~45.5M. Suggest token cap 70M to be safe.

mina_se: Hosted plan we can do scoped ephemeral key. Proposal: - allowed_models: [redwood-chat-large, redwood-chat-small] - qps: 1000 (burst) - window: 2026-06-24T13:50:00Z/2026-06-24T14:30:00Z - total_token_limit: 70000000 - streaming: true - ip_allowlist: optional (they will send subnets) - telemetry_tag: meridian-showcase

harry_sre: Operational notes: pre-warm redwood-chat-small in eu-west-1, enable KV prefix cache for repeated prompts. Add routing rule: if 95p latency > 750ms OR error_rate > 1.5% -> failover to redwood-chat-small. Also emit X-RateLimit-Remaining headers so client can surface backoff hints.

ben_eng: Cost note for finance: estimated tokens ~46M; with 70M cap that's safe. Streaming billed per token same as non-stream. I'll paste a small curl snippet for devs.

mina_se: curl snippet (replace <SCOPED_KEY>):

curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCOPED_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-large","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hey"}]}' \
  https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/chat/stream

lara_finance: Please attach the token estimate and the hard cap to the request. I'll review by Wed COB. We need a quick $ estimate for the sales deck.

olivia_sales: Will do. Also Meridian asked about rotating the key mid-window for security — is that possible without disrupting the demo?

harry_sre: Rotating mid-window is risky. Better: generate one ephemeral key that auto-expires at window end. If they insist on rotation, we can issue a second key and coordinate a brief client reconnect during a scheduled quiet minute.

mina_se: I'll add telemetry dashboards: qps, token_rate, 95p latency, error_rate. Alert to #eng-oncall and to this thread if thresholds trip.

quota-bot: Request logged: TEMP_HOSTED_BURST by olivia_sales for Meridian. Request ID: TR-2105007777. Status: pending_finance_review.

ben_eng: If finance approves, I can limit allowed_endpoints to [/v1/chat,/v1/chat/stream] and attach telemetry tags. Also recommend client set max_response_tokens=160 to limit unexpected tails.

olivia_sales: Thanks — will send the token breakdown and ask Meridian for IP subnets. Need the approved key by Thu EOD for customer testing. :pray:
